verdict.rationale: Grafana documents an official CLI (grafana-probe-5). Its observability-as-code docs describe a terminal tool that handles authentication, multiple environments, and admin tasks, and that suits CI/CD pipelines and local development (grafana-docs-26). Together these clearly cover the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output or agent workflows), detail on command coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
